name: mirage
text: Fair point, the sharing button is gone. I'm replacing it. Version 1.0.75 has the phone save its full Diagnostics report to GitHub by itself every 20 minutes, so I can read it with nothing sent by you. 1.0.74 is out now: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.74 . It has the 'nobody was selling' log and the restart wording. 1.0.75 is building and I'll message you the link. Once it's installed, leave the +EV list running for about 20 minutes and I'll read what it logged, both why bets vanish and why orders find nobody selling.
